notes: Sermon-bearing volumes 1, 3, 5–8 and 10 of the ten-volume Dwight collection; volume 9 retained as a screened non-sermon contextual volume. Not a complete surviving-manuscript census.

Posthumous Dwight collection, incorporating earlier editorial work by John Erskine, Edward Williams and Jonathan Edwards the younger. The younger Edwards is a manuscript editor here, not the preacher. Editorial consolidation is identified at component level.
Mixed-volume contents are not all sermons by the named preacher. Only explicitly inventoried components enter sermon counts.
Original-language-form describes this historic printing, not a claim of an autograph manuscript or verbatim delivery.
